source: Curated implementation-specific descriptions; not independent claims of standards compliance

privacy-redactor: Cover personal details in a photo with solid black rectangles, then export a newly rendered PNG.
Choose a JPG, PNG or WebP image; drag a rectangle over every name, address or other sensitive detail; inspect the preview before saving.
A PNG containing opaque black patches over selected pixels.
There is no automatic text detection. Unselected details remain visible, and output images are limited to 4,096 pixels on the longest edge.
submission-auditor: Compare a list of required filenames with local attachments to find missing, duplicated and oversized files.
Enter one exact required filename per line, set the size ceiling in MB, select the actual files and run the comparison.
An on-screen report and downloadable CSV of each file and its checking status.
Only filenames and file sizes are checked; this is not a content, signature or formatting inspection.
shift-calendar: Create a yearly rotating shift roster from an anchor date and repeating day, night or off-duty pattern.
Set the date for the first pattern entry, enter comma-separated shift names and choose the year; review the result and export ICS.
A dated shift table and an all-day calendar ICS import file.
Exact start/end work times, public holidays and shift swaps must be verified separately.
worktime-analyzer: Time each stage of a manual process and export completed measurements.
Enter the job and one stage per line; start the timer and mark a stage complete whenever the next stage begins.
A stage-by-stage time summary and CSV of completed measurements.
Closing the tab loses unsaved measurements. A single observation is not a production time standard.
label-sheet-maker: Arrange numbered, custom-size product labels on a printable A4 page.
Enter label text, dimensions in millimetres, quantity and optional starting serial number; check the sheet preview.
Printable A4 label pages that can be saved to PDF through the browser print dialog.
Real printed dimensions depend on print scaling and the printer's non-printable margins.
cut-plan-optimizer: Lay out rectangular cuts on source boards while accounting for a specified saw kerf.
Enter source-board width and height, kerf, and each cut as width, height, quantity; enable rotation if allowed.
The shelf-packing heuristic is not an optimum solution and does not account for cut order, grain or machine clearance.
recurring-payment-finder: Look for the same merchant and amount appearing in multiple months of a local transaction CSV.
Choose a CSV with a header row, specify its date, merchant and amount column numbers and review repeated charges.
A downloadable CSV of recurring-charge candidates with their months and amounts.
Repeated purchases can be false positives; variable-price subscriptions and differing merchant names may be missed.
meal-timeline: Work backward from a target mealtime to plan preparation and cooking for several dishes.
Enter the planned serving date/time and dishes as name, preparation minutes, cooking minutes; generate the schedule.
A chronological list of preparation, cooking and serving steps.
The plan does not resolve conflicts over burners, cookware or attention, so simultaneous tasks require review.
handover-checklist: Record item condition, included accessories and photos before a handover or second-hand sale.
Describe the item, list accessories, tick those confirmed, add notes and optional images; generate the handover report.
A printable item checklist and photo record.
This is not an authenticated digital signature, proof of ownership or independent condition certification.
group-order-summary: Collect individual food or drink orders, combine item quantities and prepare a payment breakdown.
Add each person's name, menu choice, options, quantity and price; review menu totals and individual amounts.
A consolidated order table, CSV export and per-person packing labels.
Orders are not sent to a restaurant and prices reflect only the user-entered values.
image-compress-lab: Resize and compress several JPG, PNG or WebP photos, then download the output as a ZIP archive.
Choose up to 40 images, output format, maximum dimensions and quality; optionally set a target size and run compression.
A ZIP with individually compressed images and a before/after size table.
Lossless PNG ignores the quality setting, and the target size is not guaranteed. EXIF metadata is not retained.
pdf-page-workshop: Merge PDFs, rearrange, delete or rotate pages, and export a new document.
Upload up to eight non-encrypted PDF files, use the up/down or drag controls to rearrange pages, then download.
A newly assembled PDF with the selected page order and rotations.
Encrypted or damaged PDFs may fail; this tool does not edit OCR text or preserve every signature.
bulk-file-renamer: Apply consistent prefixes, suffixes, substitutions and serial numbers to many files.
Select files, specify naming rules, preview each change and check for collisions before exporting.
A ZIP archive containing files with their new filenames.
Original files are not renamed in place. Operating-system filename constraints may vary.
room-layout-planner: Place furniture to scale on a room floor plan and identify overlaps before purchasing.
Enter room and furniture measurements in centimetres; drag, rotate or delete items to arrange the plan.
A floor plan saved as PNG and structured JSON.
Window, door placement and electrical connections are not surveyed automatically. Door clearance is illustrative.
quote-document-maker: Create a printable itemized quotation or transaction statement from user-entered prices.
Enter company/customer names, product lines, quantities, unit prices and optional VAT; generate and print the document.
A formatted quotation or statement for browser printing or PDF saving.
This is not a government e-invoice or verification of tax registration; tax settings must be reviewed.
warranty-deadline-tracker: Keep purchase dates, return deadlines, warranty expiry dates and receipts together in the browser.
Enter a product and the merchant's actual deadlines; attach a receipt if needed; save the record and export a calendar file.
A local product list, JSON backup and ICS calendar events.
Data is stored in this browser only; clearing local data removes it unless backed up. Reminder alerts depend on importing the ICS.
share-qr-card: Make printable QR sharing cards for web links, Wi-Fi details or contact information.
Select the information type, enter the relevant address or credentials, choose a caption and generate a QR image.
A PNG QR code and printable sharing card.
Wi-Fi passwords and contact details are readable inside the QR. Scan with a second device before public use.
seller-profit-math: Calculate per-item profit, profit margin and break-even sale price after costs and fees.
Enter sale price, cost, platform fees, packing, delivery and advertising costs; provide only independently verified tax rates.
An itemized profit summary and downloadable CSV.
Returns, discounts, local tax filing and specific marketplace fee rules are not determined automatically.
color-contrast-audit: Check text against background colors using WCAG 2.2 contrast ratios.
Enter two six-digit HEX colors, run the contrast test and request a passing alternative when needed.
A contrast-ratio report and a copyable black-or-white candidate color.
Solid-color contrast alone does not establish compliance for fonts, transparency or image backgrounds.
document-scan-studio: Straighten photographed paper by positioning four corners and export a cleaned PNG.
Upload a photo, drag the four corners to the paper edges, pick color or grayscale output and apply correction.
A new rectified PNG image of the selected document region.
Blurry images, folded pages and unreadable details cannot be reconstructed. Thresholding can erase faint text.
audio-quality: Inspect sample rate, channel count, peak level and possible clipped samples in an audio file.
Select an audio file, run the local inspection, compare peak and channel values, then export a report.
The tool does not establish LUFS, true peak or delivery compliance; decoded browser audio may differ from studio software.
certificate-batch: Turn a participant list into printable certificates for events or classes.
Choose a structured participant CSV, verify required name fields and generate the printable result.
Confirm names, spelling and authorization before issuing; these are not officially authenticated awards.
class-schedule-check: Find overlapping teaching or room assignments in an exported class timetable.
Provide a CSV with day, start, end, teacher and room columns; inspect flagged overlaps.
A conflict table and CSV report for manual scheduling changes.
Missing or inconsistent timetable identifiers may make conflicts invisible.
detail-image-review: Check image dimensions, ratio and file size before publishing a product detail page.
Choose product listing images and review per-image width, height and file size information.
A table identifying images requiring manual review.
This tool does not certify individual marketplace policy compliance or image rights.
dst-embroidery: Review stitch and jump commands before handing a DST design to an embroidery machine.
Choose a DST embroidery file, inspect command counts and review the machine setup separately.
A basic command and stitch summary.
A file-structure check cannot guarantee safe thread tension, stitch density or successful embroidery.
epub-preflight: Check whether an EPUB has basic required ZIP components and ebook metadata.
Select an EPUB file and inspect its package structure and required entries.
Not a full EPUBCheck conformance test or reader-device compatibility guarantee.
event-seating: Distribute attendees into table groups and review the result before an event.
Import an attendee list, define grouping requirements and generate a table layout.
Accessibility needs, relationships and venue safety restrictions need human review.
exam-variants: Create alternate question orders for different exam versions and corresponding answer keys.
Import questions, choose the required variants and compare generated orders with the original answer key.
Multiple exam forms and a matching answer key.
Content correctness, leakage and scoring policy are not verified by the tool.
inventory-diff: Compare stock ledger quantities to physical count quantities.
Choose stock and count CSV files keyed by product identifier, then inspect missing and mismatched items.
A list of quantity differences for follow-up.
Unit conversion, location transfers and cut-off dates must be reconciled separately.
invoice-reconcile: Compare invoice amounts against bank receipt records to find unmatched or differing amounts.
Upload invoice and bank CSVs keyed by invoice number; examine missing payments and amount differences.
A discrepancy report and CSV export.
Partial payments and payer-name changes may require manual investigation.
lease-registry-diff: Compare text descriptions from two property registry snapshots.
Upload two text versions, inspect added and removed clauses and verify against the originals.
This is not legal advice, registry authenticity verification or title insurance.
move-evidence: Organize property condition photos and notes for a move-in or move-out inspection.
Group photos by room and observed issue, check dates and save a printable record.
Photo records do not establish liability or replace the official tenancy agreement.
moving-boxes: Track which belongings are packed in each numbered moving box.
Enter box numbers and contents and review the packed-item list before moving.
An organized box-to-item list for unpacking.
The list is based on user entries and does not physically confirm the contents.
option-combinations: Detect repeated color, size or other product option combinations in an exported CSV.
Import a product options CSV and inspect duplicate or conflicting combinations.
The tool does not validate stock availability or platform-specific listing rules.
pdf-preflight: Inspect PDF page boxes and dimensions before commercial printing.
Select a PDF and review page dimensions, trim and bleed box information.
A PDF layout and page-box report.
Actual printer tolerances, color profiles and fonts require separate professional proofing.
photo-contact-sheet: Arrange selected pictures into a printable thumbnail index.
Choose image files and layout settings, then inspect the sheet in the browser.
The layout does not validate image rights or guarantee printer color accuracy.
photo-duplicates: Compare files to find exact binary duplicates using file hashes.
Select image files and inspect groups with matching hashes.
A list of identical files for manual cleanup.
Resized or recompressed copies with different file contents will not match.
purchase-three-way: Compare purchase orders, delivery records and invoices to find mismatched quantities and prices.
Upload the three CSV sources keyed by SKU and inspect differences before payment.
A discrepancy report for procurement review.
This does not authorize purchasing or prove goods were received in good condition.
question-similarity: Identify similar or repeated questions in an exported question CSV.
Import the question list, inspect similar entries and decide which to consolidate.
A candidate list of repeated questions.
A text similarity score does not establish equal meaning or correct answers.
shipping-audit: Compare store orders with tracking-label exports before dispatch.
Choose order and shipment files, map order identifiers and review missing, duplicate or unexpected tracking assignments.
A shipment exception list with CSV export.
A mismatch is not proof of non-delivery; combined parcels and split shipments need manual interpretation.
shotlist-maker: Organize planned shots, scenes and filming locations for a production day.
Enter or import scene and shot details, review sequence and export the list.
This does not determine real filming permits, crew safety or shoot feasibility.
show-cues: Check time ordering and possible overlaps in event or stage cue sheets.
Import cue times and descriptions, inspect ordering conflicts and save a corrected planning list.
Live show operations depend on venue and human stage management.
silence-finder: Locate quiet or silent intervals in an audio recording.
Choose an audio file, inspect detected low-level segments and review them against playback.
A list of potential silent intervals and timestamps.
Noise floors and intentionally quiet passages can affect detection; review by listening.
static-site-check: Find broken local links and missing referenced assets in a static site package.
Provide site files, inspect resource references and check any reported missing paths.
A list of potentially broken internal resources.
Dynamic network requests and server routes are not fully validated.
survey-review: Inspect survey CSV data for missing entries and inconsistent response fields.
Import an exported survey table, run checks and review the flagged responses.
An audit report for survey-data cleaning.
This does not determine whether the survey sample is unbiased or statistically representative.
svg-laser-check: Inspect an SVG's dimensions and basic elements before sending it to a laser cutter.
Choose a vector SVG and review dimensions, strokes and warning indicators.
Material parameters, cut power and physical machine safety are not verified.
tournament-maker: Generate a tournament fixture bracket from a participant list.
Enter the participants and tournament format, then inspect the bracket layout.
This is a scheduling aid, not an official organizer or result-verification service.
trip-supplies: Prepare a practical packing checklist for a planned trip.
Enter trip details and customize the generated item list before departure.
Weather, local restrictions and personal medical supplies must be checked independently.
video-delivery-check: Inspect basic codec, size and format information before submitting a video.
Select a media file and compare reported properties with the recipient's specification.
Playback quality, loudness and platform transcoding are not guaranteed.
webtoon-preflight: Inspect webtoon image sequence dimensions and file properties before upload.
Select page images, review order, width and size flags, then export the inspection result.
Individual publishing-platform restrictions and image rights need separate confirmation.
